media.title: A native iOS and macOS reconstruction of Red Alert 2 running after a long-horizon Codex task

title: Run a 26-Day Multi-Agent Native Game Reconstruction
summary: David Kalmanson reports assigning Codex a 26-day continuous task to analyze a closed-source game executable and reconstruct a 624,000-line C++ version that runs natively on iOS and macOS. He says multiple subagents divided executable analysis, implementation, play testing, and debugging; the result still has minor visual bugs, and he deliberately excluded network play.
takeaway: For an unusually long reconstruction task, divide reverse engineering, implementation, play testing, and debugging among explicit agent roles, while stating exclusions and remaining defects in the acceptance report.
